non_blocking_notes: src/rivretrieve/_internal/selection.py:342 carries a `# type: ignore[arg-type]` on `_Series(**row)`. I deleted it in the scratch copy and ran `uv run ty check src`, which printed 'All checks passed!' (execution-000054). The suppression is therefore inert: it hides no ty diagnostic, real or otherwise. It is dead weight, not a neutered gate.

`_from_frame` adds two error paths whose texts the plan does not author: 'Selection frame identity columns are not in canonical order' and 'Selection frame identity column <name> must have dtype String'. Plan section 2.7 requires the order and the exact pl.Utf8 dtypes but does not quote messages for violating them, so the executor had to author them. They are additive; no plan-quoted message is displaced.

`_Selection.__post_init__` adds two invariant guards ('Selection series must have sorted unique keys', 'Selection must carry an empty reason if and only if it has no series') that the plan states as properties but does not require be enforced at construction. This is why disabling the frame duplicate-key check (M12) still fails the suite, but with the constructor's message rather than the plan's; the plan's exact duplicate text is genuinely produced only by the `is_duplicated()` branch.

`_materialize()` rebuilds the full 197,794-row edge table from all thirteen packaged artifacts on every `find`/`pick`/`from_frame` call, and `_from_frame` additionally materializes a 197,794-entry Python dict keyed by triple. Correct, but tests/test_selection.py takes ~40s of the suite's ~450s. The plan sets no performance requirement.

Suite total is 1,637 passed / 2 skipped (execution-000005), i.e. the plan's 1,622 baseline plus the 15 new test cases (13 named tests, one of which is a 3-case parameterization). The two skips are the pre-existing folium imports in tests/test_map_stations.py.
summary:
I executed every probe through the harness and could not demonstrate a break. The artifact delivers the plan.

SCOPE, PROHIBITED EDITS, COMMIT SHAPE. `git log --oneline 4b16c57..1f3a7c7` is exactly one commit; `git log -1 --format=full` shows subject 'feat: add immutable catalogue selections' with no body and no Co-authored-by / Signed-off-by / attribution footer; `git tag --points-at 1f3a7c7` is empty. `git show --stat` lists exactly the five tracked paths of plan section 3 and nothing else: src/rivretrieve/_internal/selection.py (new, 355 lines), src/rivretrieve/_internal/discovery.py (+35), src/rivretrieve/__init__.py (+4), tests/test_selection.py (new, 292 lines), tests/test_package.py (+4). Every write-set entry the plan required to change did change. A pathspec-scoped `git diff 4b16c57...1f3a7c7 -- .pce/ pyproject.toml uv.lock tests/typecheck/` is empty, so no field under `stated` in .pce/repository-contract.json was touched, no ruff/ty/pytest configuration or gate scope moved, and tests/typecheck/nominal_window_misuse.py is untouched. Version is 0.1.49 at both src/rivretrieve/__init__.py:16 and pyproject.toml:3/:96 — no bump. pr-body.md exists at the worktree root and `git status --porcelain=v1` reports exactly `?? pr-body.md`, so it is untracked. The only new suppressions in the whole diff are one `# type: ignore[arg-type]` in src and one `# type: ignore[attr-defined]` in the test helper; there is no new noqa, no pytest.mark.skip, and no xfail. No pre-existing assertion was deleted, loosened, narrowed, or had its expected value changed: the sole edit to an existing test is the plan-mandated four-name extension of test_init_public_surface_exports_m2_provider_handle_surface's exact set (section 4). `git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=no` is empty (execution-000055); I left the worktree tracked-clean and did every mutation under /tmp.

GATES ON THE BUILT ARTIFACT. `uv run pytest -q`: 1637 passed, 2 skipped in 448.51s (execution-000005). `uv run ty check src`: 'All checks passed!' (execution-000006). `uv run ruff format --check`: '164 files already formatted', so the in-place format gate is hiding no drift (execution-000007). `uv run ruff check` without --fix: 'All checks passed!' (execution-000008). Targeted: tests/test_selection.py + tests/test_package.py, 19 passed (execution-000004).

ACCEPTANCE SUBSTANCE, MEASURED NOT READ (execution-000009). The plan's section-6 stdout probe reproduces byte-for-byte: 0 / no_catalogue_edge / ('discharge_daily_mean', 'discharge_instantaneous', 'stage_instantaneous') / 831 / 24447. I additionally executed the plan clauses that the required tests do NOT cover and confirmed each: `find(station='does-not-exist')` -> "Station is not registered: 'does-not-exist'"; a two-provider pick -> "Station is not registered for providers ('fr_hubeau', 'usgs_nwis'): 'does-not-exist'", with the same sorted rendering for both caller orders; `pick('x')` and `as_frame('x')` -> TypeError('selection must be a RivRetrieve selection'); `from_frame('x')` -> TypeError('frame must be a polars.DataFrame'); a null station_id -> FatalContractError('Selection frame contains null identity values'); a frame with only provider_id -> 'Selection frame is missing required columns: station_id, product_id', i.e. only the actually-missing names in canonical order. `find()` with no filters returns 197,794 rows = the plan's 72,769 available + 125,025 unknown exactly, which independently confirms the edge rule at whole-catalogue scale. execution-000042 confirms `find` is total over the vocabulary: sorted(providers()) equals the iter_records() id set (13 providers) and `find(provider=p)` succeeds for every one of them, and the canonical product union is character-for-character the twelve-element tuple the plan authors in section 2.4.

EVERY CHECK MUTATION-TESTED. Acceptance baseline on the same built artifact in the scratch copy at /tmp/fx-m2s1/scr: 15 passed for tests/test_selection.py, 19 passed with tests/test_package.py (execution-000028). I then applied twelve single-property mutations, each printing its own unified diff so the mutation is visible in the record, each followed by a restore. Every one was killed: (M1) edge rule `!= "unavailable"` -> `== "available"` kills the Czech-unknown test (0 != 831) and the duplicate-bare-station test; (M3) `_Series` frozen=False kills the immutability test; (M4) pick validating against selection.series instead of the catalogue kills test_pick_validates_catalogue_scope_not_input_rows and test_pick_preserves_an_existing_empty_reason; (M5) letting from_frame keep a caller-supplied `unit` kills the round-trip and metadata-rebuild tests; (M6) accepting the near-miss station '0164650' kills test_find_near_miss_station_raises_without_correction and the station parameterization; (M7) rebuilding an equal-but-not-identical _EmptyReason kills test_pick_preserves_an_existing_empty_reason on the `is` assertion; (M8) changing the render separator kills the empty-text and non-empty-text assertions; (M9) dropping the `pick` re-export kills tests/test_package.py::test_init_public_surface_exports_m2_provider_handle_surface plus six selection tests, proving the updated exact-name set has teeth; (M11) emptying published_products kills the reason test with `assert () == ('discharge_d...nstantaneous')`; (M12) disabling the frame duplicate-key check kills test_from_frame_rejects_malformed_or_absent_edges on the exact message; (M13) disabling canonical-product validation kills test_find_validates_unknown_vocabulary_independent_of_argument_count and the product parameterization with DID NOT RAISE. No check was vacuous. The delivered work adds no lint, type, or test configuration rule, so there is no rule-activating configuration entry to delete and re-check.

A NOTE ON MY OWN METHOD. My first mutation batch produced a false 'all killed' pattern because a concurrent process on this machine overwrote my scratch driver at /tmp/mut.py, so the restore/mutate steps silently no-opped and M3/M4/M5 were actually re-running M1's mutant. I caught it by diffing the scratch source against the pristine copy, re-namespaced everything under /tmp/fx-m2s1/, made each run print the unified diff of the mutation it applied, and re-ran the whole batch. The results above are from the re-run; every mutation diff is visible in its own execution record.

CLAIM HONESTY. pr-body.md matches the plan's section-9 text exactly. Its four Summary bullets are each supported: 'immutable catalogue selections at provider/station/product series grain' (frozen slotted _Series/_Selection, mutation M3 proves the frozen-ness is asserted); 'total find and catalogue-scoped pick with reason-carrying empty results' (execution-000042 shows find succeeds for all 13 providers; M4 proves pick validates against the catalogue, not the input rows); 'deterministic Polars conversion through as_frame and from_frame' (M5/M8 prove determinism and metadata rebuild are asserted); 'preserve the legacy public surface while exporting the four new functions' (the exact-set test now lists all fourteen names and M9 proves it discriminates). Its Validation section lists the six section-7 gate commands; I re-ran the four non-mutating ones and all are green. It states no figure, so there is nothing to re-measure against it.
